dynamicReads.reason: requireEnv(name) reads the variable its caller names; every caller passes a literal RIGHT_GIT_*, GITHUB_SHA, RUNNER_TEMP or LEGION_UNSIGNED_CANDIDATE_ROOT name, all listed above.
config_dir() hands std::env::var_os to config_dir_with, which asks for LIGHTCRAFT_CONFIG_DIR, HOME, APPDATA and XDG_CONFIG_HOME by literal name (all listed).
Options.token_env names the variable that holds the download token; the only caller sets "LIGHTCRAFT_SAM3_TOKEN" (listed).
ONNX_ENV is "LIGHTCRAFT_ONNXRUNTIME_DIR", and RemoteSide::from_env reads LIGHTCRAFT_DENOISE_URL and LIGHTCRAFT_DENOISE_TOKEN through a closure (all listed).
denoise-serve reads the variable named by its --token-env option (default LIGHTCRAFT_DENOISE_TOKEN, listed); the user names it.
